meta.description: Seeds are raw ideas, unprocessed concepts, and Scout Agent findings. They are the entry point for all new ideas in Mandala. Seeds that grow become tasks or roadmaps. Seeds that don't resonate are deleted.
meta.how_to_use: Seeds are collected by Scout Agent and stored in honeycombs/seeds/. Gardener reviews them manually in this chat. Promoted seeds become tasks or roadmaps in honeycombs/works/.
